title: Piper TTS adapter
summary: Adapter for Piper speech via its Python API (speed through length_scale) or a shell-free CLI argv, with lazy import, clear voice-file errors and mono float32 output.
description: Piper (piper1-gpl) is GPL-3.0 per its repository (checked 2026-10-10). This MIT adapter does not include or link Piper code; it imports the separately installed package at run time.

side_effects: loads a Piper voice model from local disk
cli_argv output, when run, starts a Python subprocess

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
